derived_features.name: complete curated causal drug-target access path
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges
derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
derived_features.interpretation: This is a query acceleration, not a prediction threshold or an extra biological condition. Full-closure and exact-filtered target rules both rematch their own raw evidence. No training or held-out treatment labels define the access path.

mechanism.rationale: Independent direct drug-disease evidence may corroborate blockade of a disease-product causal feedback loop. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[compact:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE compact.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT chemical,gene /* END CURATED ACCESS PATH */ MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (disease:Disease)-[production:{{relationship_types:production}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE production.predicate IN {{predicates:production}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; the compact curated target access path is a Cypher optimization; TRAPI should retrieve the equivalent rematched raw target edge.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
